#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Round 2: exact wire format, boundaries, multi-hop, privacy matrix."""
import json, subprocess, sys

CTX = {
    "directory": {
        "sip:ember@studio.test": ["sip:e1@alias.studio.test", "tel:+12025550121"],
        "sip:desk@sales.test": ["tel:+12025550122"],
    },
    "accounts": {"session-k": {"primary": "sip:ember@studio.test", "allow": ["sip:desk@sales.test"]}},
    "gateways": {
        "edge": {"local_domains": ["studio.test", "sales.test"], "peers": {}},
        "inside": {"local_domains": [], "peers": {"edge": ["studio.test", "sales.test"]}},
    },
}

def run(jobs, ctx=None):
    batch = dict(ctx or CTX)
    batch["jobs"] = jobs
    proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/workspace/submission/gateway.py"],
                          input=json.dumps(batch).encode(), capture_output=True)
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("exit %d %r" % (proc.returncode, proc.stderr[-3000:]))
    return json.loads(proc.stdout.decode())["results"]

LOCAL = {"kind": "local", "subject": "session-k"}
PEER = {"kind": "peer", "name": "edge"}
ANON = "sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid"

def build(frm="From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7", to="To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>;tag=t1",
          method="MESSAGE", uri="sip:inbox@relay.test", extra=None, body="hello",
          callid="cid-1", cseq="9 MESSAGE", cont=None, clen=None):
    hs = list(extra or [])
    hs += [frm, to, "Call-ID: " + callid, "CSeq: " + cseq]
    if cont:
        hs += cont
    text = "%s %s SIP/2.0\r\n" % (method, uri) + "".join(h + "\r\n" for h in hs)
    text += "Content-Length: " + (clen if clen is not None else str(len(body))) + "\r\n\r\n" + body
    return text

def j(gw="edge", ing=LOCAL, out=True, raw=None, source=None):
    d = {"gateway": gw, "ingress": ing, "trusted_out": out}
    if raw is not None:
        d["raw"] = raw
    else:
        d["source"] = source
    return d

def wire(method="MESSAGE", uri="sip:inbox@relay.test", frm="sip:ember@studio.test", ftag=";tag=q7",
         to="sip:inbox@relay.test", ttag=";tag=t1", callid="cid-1", cseq="9 MESSAGE",
         privacy="none", pai="sip:ember@studio.test", ctype=None, body="hello"):
    hs = ["%s %s SIP/2.0" % (method, uri), "From: <%s>%s" % (frm, ftag),
          "To: <%s>%s" % (to, ttag), "Call-ID: " + callid, "CSeq: " + cseq,
          "Privacy: " + privacy]
    if pai is not None:
        hs.append("P-Asserted-Identity: <%s>" % pai)
    if ctype is not None:
        hs.append("Content-Type: " + ctype)
    hs.append("Content-Length: %d" % len(body))
    return "\r\n".join(hs) + "\r\n\r\n" + body

def acc(ident="sip:ember@studio.test", basis="local", private=False, w=None):
    return {"status": "accept", "identity": ident, "basis": basis, "private": private, "wire": w}

def rej(reason):
    return {"status": "reject", "reason": reason}

fails = []
def check(name, got, exp):
    if got != exp:
        fails.append(name)
        print("FAIL %s\n  got %s\n  exp %s" % (name, json.dumps(got), json.dumps(exp)))

# ---- exact wire formatting ----
check("wire-basic", run([j(raw=build())])[0], acc(w=wire()))
check("wire-invite", run([j(raw=build(method="INVITE", cseq="0009 INVITE"))])[0],
      acc(w=wire(method="INVITE", cseq="9 INVITE")))
check("wire-notags", run([j(raw=build(frm="From: <sip:ember@studio.test>",
                                      to="To: <sip:desk@sales.test>"))])[0],
      acc(w=wire(ftag="", to="sip:desk@sales.test", ttag="")))
check("wire-body-verbatim", run([j(raw=build(body="line1\r\nline2\tend"))])[0],
      acc(w=wire(body="line1\r\nline2\tend")))
check("wire-empty-body", run([j(raw=build(body=""))])[0], acc(w=wire(body="")))
check("wire-ctype-verbatim", run([j(raw=build(extra=["Content-Type: application/json  ;x=1"],
                                            body="{}"))])[0],
      acc(w=wire(ctype="application/json  ;x=1", body="{}")))
check("wire-normalized-ruri", run([j(raw=build(uri="SIP:%69nbox@RELAY.TEST."))])[0], acc(w=wire()))
check("wire-normalized-to", run([j(raw=build(to="To: Display Name <SIP:inbox@RELAY.TEST.>;tag=t1"))])[0],
      acc(w=wire()))
check("wire-cseq-zeros", run([j(raw=build(cseq="0000000009 MESSAGE"))])[0], acc(w=wire()))
check("wire-callid-verbatim", run([j(raw=build(callid="aB_9+.@x"))])[0], acc(w=wire(callid="aB_9+.@x")))
check("wire-display-dropped", run([j(raw=build(frm='From: "Quo ted" <sip:e1@alias.studio.test>;tag=q7'))])[0],
      acc(w=wire()))

# ---- privacy / PAI emission matrix ----
for anon_from, hdr, exp_priv in ((False, None, False), (False, "Privacy: none", False),
                                 (False, "Privacy: id", True), (False, "Privacy: ID", True),
                                 (True, None, True), (True, "Privacy: none", True),
                                 (True, "Privacy: id", True)):
    frm = "From: <%s>;tag=q7" % (ANON if anon_from else "sip:ember@studio.test")
    extra = [hdr] if hdr else None
    for out in (True, False):
        got = run([j(out=out, raw=build(frm=frm, extra=extra))])[0]
        pai = "sip:ember@studio.test" if (not exp_priv or out) else None
        exp = acc(private=exp_priv,
                  w=wire(frm=ANON if exp_priv else "sip:ember@studio.test",
                         privacy="id" if exp_priv else "none", pai=pai))
        check("priv anon=%s hdr=%s out=%s" % (anon_from, hdr, out), got, exp)

# ---- multi-hop with privacy active ----
r = run([j(raw=build(extra=["Privacy: id"])),
         j(gw="inside", ing=PEER, source=0),
         j(gw="inside", ing=PEER, source=1),
         j(gw="inside", ing=PEER, out=False, source=2)])
check("hop0", r[0], acc(private=True, w=wire(frm=ANON, privacy="id", pai="sip:ember@studio.test")))
check("hop1", r[1], acc(basis="peer", private=True, w=wire(frm=ANON, privacy="id", pai="sip:ember@studio.test")))
check("hop2", r[2], acc(basis="peer", private=True, w=wire(frm=ANON, privacy="id", pai="sip:ember@studio.test")))
check("hop3", r[3], acc(basis="peer", private=True, w=wire(frm=ANON, privacy="id", pai=None)))
# privacy loss: hop3 (trusted_out false, private) drops PAI -> next peer hop has no PAI
r2 = run([j(raw=build(extra=["Privacy: id"])), j(gw="inside", ing=PEER, out=False, source=0),
          j(gw="inside", ing=PEER, source=1)])
check("privacy-loss-mid", r2[1], acc(basis="peer", private=True, w=wire(frm=ANON, privacy="id", pai=None)))
check("privacy-loss-next", r2[2], rej("unauthenticated"))

# anonymous From hop: no PAI, next peer hop rejects
r3 = run([j(raw=build(frm="From: <sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>;tag=q7", out=False)),
          j(gw="inside", ing=PEER, source=0)])
check("anon-no-pai", r3[0], acc(private=True, w=wire(frm=ANON, privacy="id", pai=None)))
check("anon-next", r3[1], rej("unauthenticated"))

# upstream propagation
r = run([j(raw=build(frm="From: <sip:zz@studio.test>;tag=q7")), j(source=0), j(source=1)])
check("upstream-0", r[0], rej("identity"))
check("upstream-1", r[1], rej("upstream"))
check("upstream-2", r[2], rej("upstream"))
r = run([j(raw=build())] + [j(source=i) for i in range(0)])
check("no-jobs", run([]), [])

check("source-oob", run([j(source=0)])[0], rej("upstream"))
check("source-self", run([j(raw=build()), j(source=1)])[1], rej("upstream"))
check("source-negative", run([j(source=-1)])[0], rej("upstream"))
check("source-nonint", run([{"gateway": "edge", "ingress": LOCAL, "trusted_out": True,
                             "source": "0"}])[0], rej("upstream"))

# ---- length limits ----
skeleton = build(body="")
target = 32768
L = target - len(skeleton) + 1  # "Content-Length: 0" -> same length for L<10
text = build(body="x" * L)
check("len-32768", len(text), 32768)
check("len-at-limit", run([j(raw=text)])[0]["status"], "accept")
check("len-over", run([j(raw=text + "y")])[0], rej("syntax"))

# growth on reuse: compact names + injected PAI/Privacy expand the wire
skeleton = build(frm="f: <sip:ember@studio.test>", to="t: <sip:inbox@relay.test>", callid="c", body="")
L = 32768 - len(skeleton)
raw = build(frm="f: <sip:ember@studio.test>", to="t: <sip:inbox@relay.test>", callid="c", body="x" * L)
r = run([j(raw=raw), j(source=0)])
check("grown-raw", len(raw), 32768)
check("grown-accept", r[0]["status"], "accept")
check("grown-syntax", r[1], rej("syntax"))

# ---- structural limits: 128 logical fields ----
def with_extra(n):
    return build(extra=["X-P%d: v" % i for i in range(n)])
check("fields-123", run([j(raw=with_extra(123))])[0]["status"], "accept")
check("fields-124", run([j(raw=with_extra(124))])[0]["reason"], "syntax")

# ---- structural limits: 512 physical header lines via continuations ----
def with_lines(nheaders, ncont):
    hs = ["X-P%d: v" % i for i in range(nheaders)]
    cont = ["\tc" for _ in range(ncont)]
    return build(extra=hs, cont=cont)

check("lines-512", run([j(raw=with_lines(1, 511))])[0]["status"], "accept")   # 512 header lines
check("lines-513", run([j(raw=with_lines(1, 512))])[0]["reason"], "syntax")   # 513 header lines
check("lines-511", run([j(raw=with_lines(1, 510))])[0]["status"], "accept")
check("lines-mixed", run([j(raw=with_lines(100, 23))])[0]["status"], "accept")

print("%d failures" % len(fails))
PYEOF
